How a midnight cake works

Cakes on the counter can be collected till 12 midnight. A photo or theme cake takes longer, so order it early.

  1. 1

    Send the order

    Fill in the order slip and send it on WhatsApp, or call the shop.

  2. 2

    Get the price and the time

    We reply with the price and the time the cake will be ready.

  3. 3

    Pick it up, or have it delivered

    Collect it from Upper Kondhwa Road before 12 midnight, or ask for home delivery: we confirm the area, the charge and the time.
